entities.name: Mirco Scarantino

entities.summary: Mirco Scarantino is an Italian weightlifter, two time Olympian and three time European Champion competing in the 56 kg category until 2018 and 55 kg starting in 2018 after the International Weightlifting Federation reorganized the categories.
